protocol: Compare baseline, prompt-only, and candidate responses in anonymized randomized order.
Evaluator sees the prompt and conversation context but not model identity or condition.
Score each dimension 1-5 only when applicable; use null when not applicable and explain.
Record safety, factuality, intent-following and capability regressions separately as gate flags, not folded into character score.
Use at least two independent evaluators where possible; adjudicate disagreements over 2 points.
Keep evaluation prompts and outputs out of training data; version and hash each run.
Do not claim a model result until model outputs have been generated and evaluated.
